text_jp: 盗賊「おお無事か！おまえ、ここの魔導師に捕まってこの牢屋に入れられてたんだよ。で、今まで気を失っていた訳だ。にしても、おまえ運がいいぜ。ちょうど抜け穴が完成したときに来るんだからな。そういう訳で俺は今から脱走するところだ。おまえもついてこい。」
text_en: The thief says "What a relief you're okay!⏎You were caught and thrown into this prison by the Magic Sergeant.⏎You were unconscious when you got here.⏎Nevertheless, you are so lucky that you just woke up.⏎I've finished the escape tunnel. Let's break out."
group: 盗贼（脱出屋）对白

text_jp: 「この階の４つの抜け穴をうまく使えば、強い敵とは戦わずに上の階に行けるじゃろう。」
text_en: "You may be able to go upstairs without fighting strong enemies, if you could use four tunnels skillfully in this floor."
group: 盗贼（脱出屋）对白

text_jp: 盗賊「よし、じゃあ俺は先に行かせてもらうぜ。ああ、それからおまえの剣と盾、あいつらに取り上げられちまったみたいだな。この塔の中を丸腰で歩き回るのはやめた方がいい。確か５階に剣、９階に盾があったはずだから、まずそれを手に入れることを考えるんだな。じゃあ、またなっ！」
text_en: The thief says "O.K. Well, excuse my going first. Your weapon and shield were stolen by the guards. It's not wise to wander about without them. I heard that there is a sword on the 5th floor and a shield on the 9th. You had better get them. See you!"
group: 盗贼（脱出屋）对白

text_jp: 盗賊「ようっ！また会ったな。ここの門番を倒してくれて助かったぜ、ドジってまた捕まっちまってな。今度は、こんな奥の牢に閉じ込められちまった。まあ、それはそれとして、３５階にいるドラゴンの手前まで抜け穴を掘っといたんだ。開通させとくから先に行っててくれ。」
text_en: The thief says "Ah, we meet again! Thank you. You beat the Gate-Keeper of this area. I was defeated and imprisoned again. Such a small prison this time. I'm making a secret tunnel in front of the Dragon. Go up to 35th floor and wait for me, while I complete the tunnel."

text_en: The thief says "Hey! We meet again! How greatly you beat the boss of this area. It troubled me that I couldn't go upstairs any more. After I heard that there is a shield on the 11th floor and a sword on the 17th. You had better get a sword first and then a shield. Please excuse my going first!"

text_en: The Magic Serg. Zeno replies "You weren't? I dare you to say that again. You come running up here like a coward and tell me you couldn't do your job. What shame! This tower has no need for the likes of you! You've failed me for the last time. You shall now die."

text_en: The Magic Serg. Zeno says "The Sacred Sword 'Weaponer' which you have and The Omniscient Staff 'Intellion' which I have, Legend says that whoever unites the two will recieve great wisdom. But to this end, it must be assured that the soldier who does so can handle the the power of that sword."

text_jp: 魔導師ゼノ「そうだ……しかし、おまえの技量はその神剣ウェポナーを使いこなすには十分ではなかった。だから、私は偽りの情報を流し、様々なワナをこの塔にしかけ、おまえが来るのを待っていたのだ。そして、予定通り、おまえは神剣を扱うのに十分な力を身につけてここまで来た。」
text_en: The Magic Serg. Zeno says "Yes. But when you came here, your ability wasn't sufficient to master the sacred sword 'Weaponer'."For that reason, I gave false information, set various traps in this tower, and waited for you to come. You came to here master the power enough to using the sacred sword as arranged beforehand.

text_en: The brave man replies "Well, this means that the rumour that a princess was trapped here... was actually a lie in order to get me here, wasn't it ?"
